Hon'ble Alok Mahra, J.
Mr. Rajat Mittal, Advocate for the
applicant.
2. Mr. Rakesh Joshi, A.G.A. for the State.
3. The applicant, who is in judicial custody
in connection with FIR/Case Crime No. 17 of
2025, under Sections 8/20/27A/29 and 60 of
NDPS Act, registered at P.S.-Raipur, District
Dehradun, has sought his release on bail.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant would
submit that applicant has falsely been
implicated in the case; that he was not
arrested from the spot and he has been made
an accused only on the confessional
statement of the co-accused, who was
arrested from the spot; that no money trail
has been found specifically connected with
the alleged illegal contraband; that other co-accused have been granted bail and that
applicant has no previous criminal history.
5. Heard learned counsel for the parties
and perused the records.
6. Per contra, learned State Counsel, on the
other hand, has vehemently opposed the bail

application.
7. Having considered the submissions,
under the facts and circumstances of the case
and also considering the fact that the other
co-accused have been granted bail and that
applicant has no previous criminal history,
this Court is of the view that it is a case fit for
bail and the applicant deserves to be enlarged
on bail.
8. Accordingly, the bail application is
allowed.
9. Let the applicant be released on bail on
executing a personal bond and furnishing two
reliable sureties each of the like amount, to
the satisfaction of the court concerned.
 (Alok Mahra J.) 16.10.2026
Ujjwal
